description.value: Starting at 8th level, the illusionist's illusions are particularly hard to dispel or counter. Whenever a caster makes a dispel check to dispel one of the illusionist's illusions, the DC is 15 + the illusionist's caster level. Whenever a caster attempts to counterspell an illusionist's illusion spell, the DC of the Spellcraft check to identify the spell increases by +5. In addition, whenever an opponent fails to counter or dispel an illusionist's illusion, they take a -2 penalty on Will saving throws to disbelieve its effects.
